correctness.rationale: Unitary equivalence reduces every basis matrix to \(A_{m,z}\). The Gram matrix has an explicit \((m-2)\)-dimensional eigenspace at \(m\), and direct expansion gives the stated cubic on the complement. The root intervals follow from exact signs at \(0,m,2m\); implicit differentiation proves monotonicity, and the asymptotic follows from the exact perturbed-root equation near \(2m\).

value.rationale: This family is the primary paper's main explicit example of Riesz-ratio divergence.
